commentary: Current spot rates show a dramatic generational cascade: H100 floor has collapsed to $1.73/hr (Vast.ai) while B200 commands $8-10/hr, suggesting prior-gen silicon is repricing faster than hyperscaler 5-6 year depreciation schedules imply. Amazon's Jan 2025 move to shorten AI server life (citing technology pace) directly contradicts Meta's simultaneous extension to 5.5 years—a $4.3B swing in opposite directions on identical hardware. CoreWeave bond yields above 16% and CDS at distressed levels (1,155+ bps) signal lenders are pricing 2-3 year effective GPU lives, not the 6-year book lives, creating a potential $176B industry-wide profit overstatement through 2028 per Burry's estimate.
